passages.note: Interview answer leans pro-life ('move us in this sort of direction of life, towards life') via culture, adoption and funding, but names no gestational limit or exception rule, so it shows a side, not a rung.
Debate answer about following the law when another state's laws are at issue concerns interstate legal cooperation, not when abortion is legal or which exceptions apply.

rows.reasoning: In the 2026-04-01 interview Hilton says his aim is "to move us in this sort of direction of life, towards life" through a culture of responsibility, adoption and ending taxpayer spending, which shows the restrictive side but states no time limit or exception rule. None of the rungs' clauses (a trimester limit with a health exception, a ban with rape, incest and life exceptions, or a ban with no exceptions) is matched, so the row is direction only.
